hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook implementing 1:1 swapping between ETH and phiEth (a wrapped ETH token). In beforeSwap, it takes the full input amount from the PoolManager, mints or burns phiEth accordingly, settles the output, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta that no-ops the AMM swap. Liquidity addition is blocked entirely, and pool initialization is restricted to ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee.
